how.gist: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes.
steps: Forearms under your shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and brace as if about to be poked in the stomach.
Breathe behind the brace and hold the line.
how.easier: Knees down, same straight line from the knees.
how.harder: A plate on your upper back.

how.gist: Lie on your back and slowly lower opposite arm and leg while your low back stays pinned.
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over your hips.
Press your low back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg until just above the floor.
how.watch: Low back lifting off the floor.
how.easier: Move only the legs, arms stay up.

how.gist: Lower the bar to your lower chest and press it back over your shoulders.
steps: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched, feet planted.
Lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows under the bar.
Press up and slightly back to over your shoulders.
how.watch: Bouncing the bar off your chest.

how.gist: Curl your hips off the floor toward your ribs, then lower them slowly.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent at ninety degrees, hands by your sides.
Curl your hips up and toward your chest.
Lower slowly until your feet nearly touch the floor.
how.watch: Swinging the legs instead of curling the hips.

how.gist: Kneel with your back shin up a wall and lift your chest to stretch the front of the hip.
steps: Back knee in the corner of wall and floor, shin up the wall.
Front foot flat, knee over the ankle.
Squeeze the back glute and lift your chest tall.
how.watch: Arching the low back instead of opening the hip.
how.easier: Move the back knee a little away from the wall.
